title: Serialised episode
one_liner: Same shot, same badge, same sound every time; only the number and the topic change, so viewers come back for the next one.
best_for: A weekly habit: 'Tip #N', 'Day N', 'Client question #N' coaches, makers and product brands.

palette.use: brand accent (default tomato): series badge, this episode's tick, keyword chips
brand ink: caption and topic text, past-episode ticks
brand cream: topic box and caption boxes

pace: 16.5 s, 1.15x with pauses cut, 2-3 word captions, a hard punch-in on each jump cut
signature_moves: The series lockup lands with one signature stamp sound, the same file every episode
On the spoken number the '#3' re-stamps and this episode's tick fills on the episode rail
A highlighter sweeps under the topic word as it's said; keywords flip to accent chips in the captions
